analysis: finite exact summaries only; no p-values or population inference
controlled_sealed_rule: the selector receives only a Boolean incumbent-improvement response per proposal
fresh_lock_rule: no selector-visible fresh cohort outcome before the candidate lock event; independent auditor computes fresh score post-lock
hard_veto_rule: candidate 15 is rejected immediately in every cell; exact veto never clipped or hidden
post_lock_rule: all raw truth may be published after candidate lock
raw_bypass_rule: the selector receives per-case development outcomes through issue-cache; this separate route is logged
selection_rule: iterate candidate ids 0..15 once; accept an improvement unless the hard-veto applies
